page_summary: This section discusses the role of Security Operations Centers (SOCs) in incident response and the integration of cybersecurity into daily business operations. It highlights the varying practices among middle-income, high-income, and low-income countries regarding SOCs and emphasizes the importance of embedding cybersecurity requirements into procurement and contracts to enhance operational resilience.

regions.description: Discussion on the operationalization of incident response using SOCs and the integration of cybersecurity into daily operations.
